question: A museum lets in at most 100 visitors an hour, but groups of up to 20 may enter together after a quiet spell. Which ticket rule fits?
options: A jar holding at most 20 tickets, refilled with one ticket every 36 seconds
100 tickets that reset exactly on the hour
One ticket per visitor, refilled only when the visitor leaves
No tickets; the guard decides by how busy the hall looks
explanation: A jar of 20 lets a group in together after a quiet time, and refilling one ticket every 36 seconds gives 100 an hour in the long run: a token bucket. Tickets that reset on the hour let 100 in at 10:59 and 100 more at 11:00.
